name: monkey-maestro
description: Linear-first project orchestration with simple capacity accounting and parallel Superset dispatch.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate Linear dependency graphs through Superset agents
interface.longDescription: Monkey Maestro uses live Linear status and blockedBy links as its only scheduling authority. In Progress issues consume the configured capacity; remaining ready issues are sent directly to Superset in one bounded parallel batch.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Linear project URL read-only and report its Maestro state.
Use Monkey Maestro to start project execution for this verified Linear project.
Use Monkey Maestro to orchestrate one fast dispatch pass for this active Linear project.
Use Monkey Maestro to inspect Superset transport for current In Progress issues without changing Linear.
Use Monkey Maestro to spawn one task-linked Superset workspace from live Linear state.
Use Monkey Maestro to stop future project dispatches without terminating active work.
